name: Grade 6 T3 Practice: November Week 1 - Present and Reflect
description: Practice words for presenting, feedback, and reflection.

words.definition: To show and explain work to others.

words.example: The feedback helped me improve the model.
We improve the route after testing.

words.definition: What you are trying to do.
words.example: The goal was to follow the route.

words.definition: A thing made during a project.
words.example: The chart was one project artifact.

words.definition: Thinking about what worked and what to improve.
words.example: The reflection described one debugging step.
